verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms `@babylonjs/core` is published on the public npm registry (v9.26.1, Apache-2.0, about 234k weekly downloads). The docs describe NPM packages for all modules and a modular design with tree-shakable ES6 modules, and a community user reports TypeScript integration works well. One user notes the engine is about three times the size of Three.js, so bundle optimization matters. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that tree-shaking reduces bundle size in practice, and in-depth bundler-integration docs (the pack has only one-line summaries).
